verdict.rationale: Poke's docs show it can be triggered by external services (GitHub, CI/CD, monitoring tools) via its API and can be extended with MCP servers, which enables event-driven automation, but there is no explicit documentation of a native scheduler, recurring/background task runner, or proactive autonomous execution loop. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron-style automation, evidence of persistent background task execution without external trigger, independent confirmation of autonomous run reliability.
